scope: Independent animation presentation review branch; no runtime integration
source_policy: Primary official pages only. Public reference availability is not a license to redistribute source artwork. Official product photos inspected in system temporary storage only.
timing_policy: All proposed timings, frame counts, pose transitions, orbit/return paths and balances are game adaptations, not source claims.

sources.verified: Article text: Sasuke uses Chidori against Gaara after training with Kakashi.
Official young-Sasuke product includes Chidori effects. Product photo 07 visually inspected.

abilities.visual_observation: Photo 07: left arm lowered near the hip, right hand across near the left arm, bent knee; branching blue lightning surrounds the low left hand.
abilities.review_red_flag: Canonical charge reference uses Sasuke's LEFT hand. Whole-sequence game mirroring is allowed, but anatomical hand identity must remain consistent between frames. Reject an unmirrored right-hand charge even if an image-generation prompt mistakenly requested it.
abilities.proposed_action: Distinct low-hand charge, forward-leaning hand-led thrust, short branching electric trails and recovery. Match hand attachment in both mirrored directions.
abilities.adaptation: Multi-target chain, acceleration, camera freeze and invincibility remain existing survival-game mechanics. Chidori and Kakashi's Lightning Blade are not claimed to be canonically identical names.

sources.verified: Episode 130 description identifies Sasuke's Fireball as an Uchiha family technique taught by his father.
Product photos 06 (chest-level seal) and 08 (fire-breathing stance) visually inspected.

abilities.visual_observation: Photo 08: right hand close to mouth, narrow flame connection widening to a large orange/yellow fire head; opposite arm opens back for balance.
abilities.proposed_action: Chest seal, mouth-level breathing pose, narrow mouth jet widening into the fireball, visible exhale recovery.
abilities.adaptation: Persistent growing collision AOE, travel distance growth and wall blocking are existing game rules; product photo does not establish continuous damage ticks or exact timing.

sources.verified: Official episode-one introduction identifies Naruto stealing the sealing scroll and discovering a rare power; does not describe individual fingers.
Official early-series retrospective discusses Naruto's graduation and later transformation/shadow-clone teamwork against Zabuza.

abilities.visual_observation: Existing game reference uses the Team 7 hands-together row. Full official animation and individual finger positions were not frame-verified in this research pass.
abilities.proposed_action: Recognizable crossed-finger silhouette at chest height, brief hold, white smoke puffs and staggered clone landing; reject arms-raised substitute.
abilities.adaptation: Exact seal depiction is an art direction proposal here; 8/16/24/32/40 counts, independent combat and duration are game mechanics.

sources.verified: Minato Column 5 explains intense chakra rotation compressed in the palm, with manga references to chapters 155 and 167.

sources.publisher: NARUTO OFFICIAL SITE / Shinobi Striker development team
sources.verified: Official licensed-game adaptation describes young Naruto finishing a shadow-clone combo with an assisted Rasengan; this is game presentation, not an exhaustive manga rule.

abilities.visual_observation: Official explanatory text establishes a contained rotating palm sphere. Blue-white color, proposed pose sequence and helper staging are art direction rather than independently frame-measured findings.
abilities.proposed_action: Palm-supported tight rotating sphere, optional brief clone assistance, forward body weight and hand-led impact; avoid turning it into a detached generic light bullet.
abilities.adaptation: AOE radius, knockback, repeated casts and short startup are survival-game design.

sources.verified: Product description associates Fuma Shuriken with the Zabuza battle; photo 05 visually inspected.

abilities.visual_observation: Four broad black curved blades with thin silver edges and a central hand grip. Throw preparation includes torso twist and an extended balancing arm.
abilities.proposed_action: Wind-up with weapon near hip, torso rotation, distinct release and recovery; keep the weapon silhouette readable during spin.
abilities.adaptation: Curved homing-style outbound path, automatic return and multiple simultaneous weapons are requested game mechanics.

sources.verified: Uchiha sword technique entry describes iai-style draw-and-slash and lightning-coated blade.
Official Shippuden Sasuke product lists sword, sheathed/partly sheathed sword and Chidori effect; blade silhouette was not newly photo-inspected in this pass.

abilities.visual_observation: Documented draw-and-cut sword handling; use the already accepted slender silver blade and black handle as the project's visual baseline.
abilities.proposed_action: Brief draw-like activation pose and restrained blue edge streaks; make the selected-skill orbit legible without hiding Sasuke.
abilities.adaptation: Young-Sasuke appearance plus later swordsmanship is cross-era adaptation; autonomous flying-sword orbit/multiplicity is not canonical sword handling. Preserve disappear-on-skill-switch behavior.

sources.verified: Official revenge-arc retrospective covers Sasuke and Itachi; use for later-stage technique context, not exact icon tracing.

sources.publisher: NARUTO OFFICIAL SITE / NINJA VOLTAGE announcement
sources.verified: Licensed-game announcement supplies Susanoo combat-presentation context; game balance is not manga evidence.

abilities.visual_observation: Use the user's supplied red/black progression chart and already accepted circular icons as the exact project pattern reference. No eye whites.
abilities.proposed_action: Subtle activation flash and clear stage-dependent iris silhouette; reserve larger black flame and purple rib/arm presentation for their own evolved stages.
abilities.adaptation: Five cumulative stages, passive dodge, pickup radius, extra projectile, pull vortex and run-permanent black fire are game adaptations.

sources.verified: Rasengan evolution section identifies Wind Style: Rasen Shuriken and manga chapter 339.
Kakuzu battle recap describes a failed first attempt followed by a clone-assisted misdirection and direct hit.

abilities.visual_observation: Text establishes wind-nature evolution of the Rasengan; a rotating bright core with broad wind-blade silhouette is proposed art direction, not measured animation frames.
abilities.proposed_action: Separate formation, held spinning silhouette, release and wind impact; keep visual distinction from the compact Rasengan.
abilities.adaptation: Free ranged throwing and repeat volleys reflect the current game, not a claim that the first Kakuzu-battle version could always be thrown.

sources.verified: Final Valley retrospective documents Nine Tails' cloak increasing speed, chakra counterattacks and protection against Sasuke's fire jutsu.

abilities.visual_observation: Use the red one-tail project baseline. Do not substitute later golden chakra-mode costume or arbitrary multiple tails.
abilities.proposed_action: Low aggressive stance, one distinct red chakra tail, compact claw/arm extensions and restrained ripple on counterattack.
abilities.adaptation: Temporary attack/defense/speed bonuses and circular periodic counterattack are game design.
